abilities.desc_zh: 该机器人能够对其防御、进攻和电力系统进行升级。
abilities.desc_en: Upgrade - This bot is able to construct Upgrades to his Defensive, Offensive, and Power Systems.

abilities.desc_zh: 随着时间的推移造成能量伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Shock - Deals Energy Damage over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 随着时间的推移，减去一定百分比的对手力量。
abilities.desc_en: Power Leak - Substracts a percentage of the opponents' Power over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 修复随着时间的推移失去的生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Repair - Repairs lost Health over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 建筑工程
abilities.desc_en: Construction

abilities.title_en: Each time Wheeljack Transforms he begins to Construct a random Upgrade for {{var_1}}. [Max 3 Upgrades]
abilities.desc_zh: 每次千斤顶变形时，他都会开始为 {{var_1}} 构建随机升级。 [最多3次升级]
abilities.desc_en: Each time Wheeljack Transforms he begins to Construct a random Upgrade for {{var_1}}. [Max 3 Upgrades]

abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack Is struck by a Critical Melee Hit while Constructing, the Construction Fails and the Upgrade is lost.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶在建造时被致命的近战攻击击中，建造就会失败并且升级也会丢失。
abilities.desc_en: If Wheeljack Is struck by a Critical Melee Hit while Constructing, the Construction Fails and the Upgrade is lost.

abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack is hit with a critical heavy attack or a critical special attack, the Upgrade is destroyed and the upgrade is lost.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶受到严重重击或严重特殊技，升级就会被破坏并且升级会丢失。
abilities.desc_en: If Wheeljack is hit with a critical heavy attack or a critical special attack, the Upgrade is destroyed and the upgrade is lost.

abilities.desc_zh: 升级
abilities.desc_en: Upgrades

abilities.title_en: Defensive Upgrade: {{var_2}} Damage Resistance and increases to the chance Special Attacks will inflict Stun by {{var_3}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 防御升级：{{var_2}} 伤害抗性并增加特殊技造成 {{var_3}} 眩晕的几率。
abilities.desc_en: Defensive Upgrade: {{var_2}} Damage Resistance and increases to the chance Special Attacks will inflict Stun by {{var_3}}.

abilities.title_en: Offensive Upgrade: {{var_4}} Attack Rating and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Shock by {{var_5}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 进攻升级：{{var_4}} 攻击评级并增加特殊技造成 {{var_5}} 触电的几率。
abilities.desc_en: Offensive Upgrade: {{var_4}} Attack Rating and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Shock by {{var_5}}.

abilities.title_en: Power Upgrade: {{var_6}} Power Rate and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Power Leak by {{var_7}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 力量升级：{{var_6}} 力量速率并增加特殊技造成 {{var_7}} 力量泄漏的几率。
abilities.desc_en: Power Upgrade: {{var_6}} Power Rate and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Power Leak by {{var_7}}.

abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack is struck by a Melee Critical Hit from a Special or Heavy Attack the newest Upgrade constructed will be removed.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶被特殊技或重击的近战暴击击中，则构建的最新升级将被删除。
abilities.desc_en: If Wheeljack is struck by a Melee Critical Hit from a Special or Heavy Attack the newest Upgrade constructed will be removed.

abilities.title_en: Success: If Wheeljack Constructs 3 of the same Upgrade type he randomly Repairs between {{var_8}} of Max Health.
abilities.desc_zh: 成功：如果千斤顶建造了 3 个相同的升级类型，他会在最大生命值的 {{var_8}} 之间随机修复。
abilities.desc_en: Success: If Wheeljack Constructs 3 of the same Upgrade type he randomly Repairs between {{var_8}} of Max Health.

abilities.desc_zh:
千斤顶的紧急力量护盾使他能够在实验室中潜在的致命攻击和灾难性事故中幸存下来。

{{var_9}}、{{var_10}}、{{var_11}} 生命值：如果敌人的攻击将千斤顶的生命值降低到 {{var_12}}、{{var_13}} 或 {{var_14}} 以下，则力力护盾将激活，减少 {{var_15}} 敌人攻击造成的所有伤害，持续 {{var_16}} 秒。

+{{var_17}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Force Shield
Wheeljack’s emergency Force Shield allows him to survive both potentially deadly attacks and catastrophic mishaps in the lab.
{{var_9}}, {{var_10}}, {{var_11}} Health: If an enemy attack would reduce Wheeljack’s health below {{var_12}}, {{var_13}} or {{var_14}}, Force Shield will activate, reducing all damage from enemy attacks by {{var_15}} for {{var_16}}seconds.
+{{var_17}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 千斤顶为所有汽车人团队成员提供每场战斗的随机被动升级。升级可在战斗期间授予+{{var_36}}~{{var_37}}攻击评级、+{{var_38}}~{{var_39}}伤害抗性或+{{var_40}}~{{var_41}}功率等级。
abilities.desc_en: Upgrades – Bumblebee, Jazz - Wheeljack provides all Autobot team members a random Passive Upgrade each fight. Upgrades grant either +{{var_36}}~{{var_37}} Attack Rating, +{{var_38}}~{{var_39}} Damage Resistance, or +{{var_40}}~{{var_41}} Power Rate for the duration of the fight.

abilities.desc_zh: 当同时造成 3 个或更多触电时，冲击波有 {{var_42}}~{{var_43}} 几率对 {{var_44}} 造成眩晕。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Gain – Shockwave - Shockwave has a {{var_42}}~{{var_43}} chance to inflict Stun for {{var_44}} when inflicting 3 or more Shocks simultaneously.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_45}}~{{var_46}} 增加对拆除机器人的攻击。只有当团队中的所有机器人都具有这种协同羁绊时，Shockwave 才能获得此优势。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Shockwave - {{var_45}}~{{var_46}} Increase to Attack against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only gets this benefit if all bots on his team have this synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为团队的领导灯塔，所有较低级别的机器人都获得 +{{var_47}} 功率率。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier Bots gain +{{var_47}} Power Rate.
